title: Cardinality of the space of coefficient functions
statement:
Fix natural numbers $n$ and $D$, and write $\mathcal{S}_{n,D}$ for the type of supports of squarefree monomials of degree at most $D$ in $n$ variables. For any finite type $K_0$, the number of functions from $\mathcal{S}_{n,D}$ to $K_0$ is
\[
\abs{\mathcal{S}_{n,D} \to K_0} \;=\; \abs{K_0}^{\,\abs{\mathcal{S}_{n,D}}}.
\]
replaced:
For a finite type $K_0$, the number of coefficient functions on low-degree supports is
\[
\abs{\mathcal{S}_{n,D} \to K_0}
  \;=\; \abs{K_0}^{\,\abs{\mathcal{S}_{n,D}}} .
\]
